newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NS cargo study on trains between Schiphol and F'furt.
newsitem.headline: NS cargo study on trains between Schiphol and F'furt.

text.p: NS Cargo, the cargo arm of Netherlands Railways, NS, is studying the possibility of operating airfreight trains between Schiphol Amsterdam Airport and Frankfurt.
A spokesman for NS Cargo, told Reuters from the company's Utrecht headquarters, that the plan is in its very early stages.
Possibilities being considered are combining passenger trains with freight wagons or operating light, freight trains between the two.
The light train would essentially be trucks on a rail train, he said. "The latter option enables a quick and efficient way of combining trains." he added.
Perhaps these trains could be something similar to the Cargo Sprinter that has just been launched in Germany by the Germany railways, Deutsche Bahn, said the spokesman.
The study, carried out by NS Cargo together with the University of Tilburg in the Netherlands, has concluded that airfreight trains would be profitable, he added.

However, which companies will operate the trains is still to be decided. It may be NS Cargo alone, or in combination with other cargo train operators or even with integrators and airfreight companies, he added.
The study will be concluded by the end of the year, he said - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017
